peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (29.8): 2.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 114 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Initial resale-wave effect: 0 of the 3 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Jul 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 8.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 3.8 resales per 100 homes a year over 14 months (Aug 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 245 of 379 similar developments. First resale wave from Aug 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date); 1 earlier resale does not start the wave. Observed 24-month activity: 2.2.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Novena MRT about 860 m, Farrer Park MRT about 1,060 m; closer than 49 of 662 similar developments (the same as 4). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 11 within 2 km; nearest Hong Wen School about 640 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 10 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 150 m), more than 426 of 662 similar developments (the same as 86); nearest hawker centre Whampoa Drive Makan Place/Whampoa Market about 250 m; nearest park Toa Payoh Town Park about 840 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 5 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,320 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,330 m; Sanctuary@Newton, 16 new sales, about 1,370 m; 32 Gilstead, 3 new sales, about 1,540 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,900 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 304 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 77 new sales and 834 resales (911 purchases); new sales were 8.5% of these purchases. Subsales (44) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 834 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 376 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 834 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 906 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7.9%). Planning-area private resales −6.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
